name: io.github.bnth09productions-maker/scrapling-x402-store-gov
title: Scrapling US Gov Contracts, Nonprofits & Sovereign BTC
description: USAspending federal contracts, IRS Form 990 nonprofits, country BTC & CISA KEV CVEs via x402.

tools.name: free_gov_contracts
tools.description: FREE. The 3 largest new U.S. federal prime contracts of the last 7 days from USAspending.gov (hourly): prime contractor, UEI, amount, agency, NAICS, place of performance, award link. gov_contracts ($0.01) filters every new award; gov_winners ($0.01) ranks top primes.

tools.name: free_country_btc_holdings
tools.description: FREE. Official, on-chain and court-record Bitcoin holdings for countries and governments, with as-of dates, sources, method badges and a CSV download. Human page at /countries. Not investment advice. Returns JSON country and government Bitcoin holdings with as-of dates, sources, and method badges.

tools.name: gov_contracts
tools.description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Newly awarded U.S. federal prime contracts (or grants/loans via type) from the public USAspending.gov API, largest first: award id, prime recipient + UEI, amount, agency/sub-agency, NAICS, PSC, place of performance, dates, description, usaspending.gov link. Filters: type, state, state_scope (performance|recipient), naics (2/4/6-digit), psc, agency, min_amount, days (1-90, default 7; 90 for grants/loans), limit. DoD contracts appear after a 90-day delay. Covered by pass_day/pass_month. No charge on failure.

naics.description: NAICS code(s) or 2/4/6-digit prefixes, comma list (contracts)

agency.description: Awarding agency abbreviation (VA, DHS, HHS, NASA) or name

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

tools.name: gov_winners
tools.description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Top U.S. federal prime recipients ranked by total new award dollars in the window (USAspending.gov): name, UEI, location, total, award count, top agencies/NAICS, largest new award with link. Same filters as gov_contracts; limit 1-50 (default 25). Covered by pass_day/pass_month. No charge on failure.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

tools.name: nonprofit_lookup
tools.description: Any IRS-recognized US exempt organization by EIN or name (+ optional state): name, city/state, 501(c) subsection, NTEE code, ruling date, deductibility, foundation type, IRS BMF asset/income/revenue amounts and Form 990 / 990-EZ / 990-PF financials per tax period (revenue, expenses, assets, liabilities, net assets, contributions, program revenue, officer compensation, salaries, employees, grants paid). From IRS public data files. $0.005

limit.description: Max orgs for name search (default 10, max 50)

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

tools.name: kev_lookup
tools.description: Search CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog by cve, vendor, product, keyword q, days since added, ransomware use: CVE, vendor, product, name, date added, federal due date, ransomware use, required action, CWEs, plus NVD CVSS base score, severity, version and vector. Newest first. $0.003

days.description: Added in the last N days

limit.description: Max rows (default 50, max 500; free preview stays at 3)
